work_item: Create artifacts/project-summary.md containing a comprehensive summary of the Engineering Loop v11.3 project, covering: project overview, architecture, key features, directory structure, stages, skills, configuration, and version history.
ideation: The work item requires creating `artifacts/project-summary.md` — a comprehensive summary of Engineering Loop v11.3. Based on my exploration of the project, I've gathered all necessary information from README.md (1923 lines), CORE.md (237 lines), ORCHESTRATOR.md (750 lines), START.md (238 lines), config-template.yaml (206 lines), state-template.json (45 lines), skill-index.md (79 lines), and directory listings for stages/ (24 stage files), skills/ (11 built-in skill directories), references/ (15 reference files), and eng_loop/src/eng_loop/ (14 Python modules). The summary needs to cover: project overview (persistent while-loop engine for AI-assisted dev, dynamic graph construction), architecture (multi-project via git submodule, LangGraph StateGraph, dual-mode CLI/LLM), key features (26 stages across 7 phases, auto-sizing by complexity, TDD per task, evidence gates, surgical CLI, context optimization with ProjectMap + ToolResultCache), directory structure (framework root, stages, skills, references, eng_loop Python package), stages (full catalog with IDs, phases, min complexity), skills (11 built-in + 7 self-constructed), configuration (two-layer config, model settings, constraints, hardware, dynamic graph, state history), and version history (v9.0.0 through v11.3.0). This is a small complexity documentation task — a single focused write operation.
